decisions.reason: The industrial AC voltage input module has its own product page and supports the announced energy-management direction, so management stays committed and treats any weak sales as a temporary ramp-up.
The four-channel solid state relay sits close to the core automation line and costs little to maintain, so keeping it fits the firm's commitment to a complete building block system.

The server room kit is peripheral to the charging and standalone-controller direction, but it only bundles existing modules, so the cost of keeping it is low and management keeps it for now despite rising risk.
The RGB LED control module launched only recently, and management has just invested in it, so early results would be attributed to its newness rather than failure.
The remote access service for wallboxes is central to the announced expansion of charging and energy management, so it carries strong public commitment and justification pressure to persist.
